<answer>
To remove the door panel on a 2006 Chevy, first remove the two screws located inside of the door pull cup and one in the middle of the inside door handle. Additionally, there's a pin on the outer edge of the door that holds the panel in place which needs to be removed. Then use a door panel removal tool to pry the door panel off. Ensure to remove all screws and clips in the door panel and gently pull the panel away from the frame. Finally, remove any wiring connections and the panel will come off the frame.
</answer>
